title: Rabbi Tanchum bar Ila
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He spoke in the name of Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Chanina: Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah, chapter 1, beginning of halakhah 2.
In Jerusalem Talmud Maaserot 1:2: Rabbi Aivu bar Nagri and Rabbi Tanchum bar Ilai in the name of Rabbi Nachum son of Rabbi Simai.

In Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:1: Rabbi Ba bar Zavda, Rabbi Tanchum bar Ilai and Rabbi Yoshiya went out to a fast — Rabbi Tanchum bar Ilai expounded (Hyman suggests the reading “son of Rabbi Chanilai”).
He is mentioned with a halakhah in Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 2:3 and Shabbat 3:1. He died on Chanukah, as in the Jerusalem Talmud, end of Moed Katan.

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:1 names Tanchum bar Ilai with Ba bar Zavda and Yoshiya. Hyman’s Chanilai emendation and the death-on-Chanukah report are retained as his claims rather than established by this one passage.
